# SpectralSpikeEncoding

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method that encodes time-series signals into spike trains based on their Fourier transform coefficients, preserving frequency information in spike timing. Bridges continuous spectral features with event-driven computation, critical for energy-efficient neuromorphic time-series analysis.
